notes: Whether qa-tester/testing-apps record run evidence (a video per scenario: happy path, error handling, edge cases; and a folder per bug with its screenshot and video). mode: "auto" (default) records and saves every run without asking; "ask" makes the delegating conversation ask the user before each run. Where evidence goes is not set here: it lands in the product's own workDir, under <workDir>/qa-evidence/<ticket-or-session>/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<web|ios|android>/ with testing/{happy-path,error-handling,edge-cases}/ and bugs/<bug-n>-<slug>/. An optional "dir" here is only a fallback for runs that match no product config.
